description: Internal Evidence Lab operations pack for converting incoming work into executable task cards and maintaining a deterministic per-owner queue.

rules.reason: The operator needs to create, triage, prioritize, complete, or archive Evidence Lab tasks.

interface.short_description: Create and rank executable Evidence Lab tasks.
interface.long_description: Turns raw requests into consistent task cards, verifies their fields, and maintains a gated per-owner execution order without losing completion history.
interface.default_prompt: Create these Evidence Lab tasks, assign the required fields, and update the execution order.
